title: Browser: open ownx.co and sum it up
html:
load up the website ownx.co
16:52
The page loaded successfully. It's the OwnX homepage for "Scalable Private Intelligence (SPI)".

Key things on the page:

Five layers of innovation:
1. Own 1 — personal AI computer
2. OwnX — private AI platform
3. OwnXOS — AI-native operating system
4. OwnXCloud — Supercloud infrastructure
5. EarthCompute — compute resource management

Two main products highlighted:
- Own 1 — "A mind of your own" — a personal AI computer with two local models and eight agents, no subscription, no per-token cost
- OwnX — browser-accessible AI platform with unlimited tokens, starting at $8/million tokens

Navigation sections: Products, Solutions (Individuals, Builders, Enterprise, Public Sector), Company, Resources, and Guides.

There are interactive sliders for tokens per day, API pricing, and a comparison chart between "renting" vs "owning" AI infrastructure.
